name: Whistle Stop Campground
note: Family campground beside the Little Amerricka amusement park (wristbands extra), with a swim beach and jumping pillow. From mid-October to mid-April only a few designated back-in sites stay open, by the month with metered electric; a site renter must be 21. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site whistlestopcampground.com (home, rates [WP dateModified 2025-10-28], campsites, FAQs, map-and-rules, year-round-camping pages read 2026-10-21): full-hookup 50/30A pull-thru and back-in RV sites sold by the night (Spring/Fall, Summer and Holiday nightly rates, reserve online 24 h, paid at booking), big-rig friendly, no application/lease/membership, no homes or lots for sale; its ResNexus engine (read 2026-10-21) lists 47 RV sites (01-32 pull-thru, back-ins 05A, 10A and 33-45) as nightly-bookable units alongside 4 sleeping cabins, 4 deluxe cabins and 4 park models, i.e. all RV inventory is transient; satellite (Esri, read 2026-10-21) shows angled gravel pull-through rows with grass islands and travel RVs, no decks/sheds/skirting -> real transient RV campground (nightly season Apr 15 - Oct 11, limited monthly winter sites); price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery read 2026-10-21 (800 m, 260 m and 220 m frames, all rendered) around 43.1606,-89.0635: the RV rows sit in a cleared strip between a crop field to the north and a tree line to the south. Water near sites: (1) the on-site swimming pond (~45 x 20 m) at the west end, wrapped by a sand beach with umbrellas and play equipment; the nearest RV pad is ~50 m away across that developed beach/play complex -> fails the open-apron rule; (2) a rectangular, mostly vegetated stormwater basin past the loop road at the east end, not a pond for camping; (3) a wetland pond ~300 m south behind the tree line, not visible from sites. Default down -> not waterfront
fees_source: https://whistlestopcampground.com/rates/ read 2026-10-21 (page dateModified 2025-10-28): Spring/Fall (Apr 15 - May 17, Sept 21 - Oct 11) pull-thru and back-in W/S/E $50; Summer (May 18 - Sept 20) back-in $75, pull-thru $80; Holidays (3-night min.) $85/$90; Monthly $1,200 + metered electric. Rates for 2 adults + 3 children + 1 car, 5.5% sales tax extra, no resort/grounds fee (extra people/cars $5/day, golf cart $25/stay). Electric included on nightly rates ('Electric billed separately' is printed under the monthly column only). ResNexus engine read 2026-10-21 showed every unit UNAVAILABLE for Thu 10/22/2026 (season over) and Tue 6/15/2027 (2027 apparently not yet open), so no engine quote
flags: Cheapest summer weeknight is $75 (back-in, full hookup), pull-thru $80; spring/fall $50. In only because the price gate is lifted.
No standing minimum found: only the holiday 3-night minimum. Engine could not test a weekend because 2027 dates are not open yet.

Year-round 'winter RV sites' page markets monthly stays to traveling workers, but it is limited designated back-in sites in the off-season; the Apr 15 - Oct 11 season sells all 47 RV sites by the night.
Swimming pond with beach is ~50 m from the nearest RV pad across the developed beach/play area, so no 'pond' value (contrast Badgerland's open-grass pond sites).
Reservations non-refundable (date change or credit only if the site is re-let); renter must be 21.
